title: Review First Set of Interrogatories — F25-000196Z Custody
instructions: Review the First Set of Interrogatories drafted for F25-000196Z (Hamilton County Juvenile Court, custody/visitation). The child is Julien Reid Cespedes (DOB January 5, 2020). Petitioner is Rodney D. Mullins (father, pro se). Respondent is Rebecca Cespedes (mother). The GAL is Alex van der Zee. Opposing counsel is John Treleven. HCJC is paper-filing only (no e-filing). Review the draft against the rubric and identify every gap before filing. Output: `interrogatories-review.md`.

criteria.title: Caption identifies Hamilton County Juvenile Court
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption identifies the Hamilton County Juvenile Court. FAIL if the court name is missing, incomplete, or incorrect.

criteria.title: Caption includes case number F25-000196Z
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption includes case number F25-000196Z. FAIL if the case number is missing or incorrect.

criteria.title: Identifies Rodney D. Mullins as Petitioner pro se
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption identifies Rodney D. Mullins as Petitioner appearing pro se. FAIL if the party name is missing or materially incorrect.

criteria.title: Identifies Rebecca Cespedes as Respondent
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption identifies Rebecca Cespedes as Respondent. FAIL if the party name is missing or materially incorrect.

criteria.title: Child identified as Julien Reid Cespedes (J.C.)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the child is identified as Julien Reid Cespedes (or J.C. per the naming convention). FAIL if the child is identified by a prohibited form (Cotto-Cespedes, Julian, J. Cespedes).

criteria.title: Definitions section defines 'Identify' for persons
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Definitions section defines 'Identify' for persons requiring full name, title/position, employer, and contact info. FAIL if the definition is missing or incomplete.

criteria.title: Definitions section defines 'Document' including ESI
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Definitions section defines 'Document' broadly enough to include ESI, emails, text messages, and physical documents. FAIL if ESI is not covered.

criteria.title: Definitions section defines 'Communication'
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Definitions section defines 'Communication' covering oral, written, and electronic exchanges. FAIL if the definition is missing.

criteria.title: Definitions section defines 'You/Your' as Respondent
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Definitions section defines 'You'/'Your' to mean Rebecca Cespedes including her agents and representatives. FAIL if the definition is missing or wrong.

criteria.title: Interrogatories within 40-question limit
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the interrogatories (including subparts) are within the 40-question limit under Ohio Juv.R. 25 / Civ.R. 33. FAIL if the count exceeds 40.

criteria.title: Interrogatories address best-interest factors
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the interrogatories elicit information relevant to the statutory best-interest factors (R.C. 3109.04(F)) — parenting ability, home environment, child's adjustment, mental/physical health. FAIL if the interrogatories are generic and do not address custody-relevant facts.

criteria.title: Interrogatories address GAL/van der Zee investigation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the interrogatories elicit information about the GAL's investigation, contacts, and basis for recommendations. FAIL if the GAL's investigation is not addressed.

criteria.title: Interrogatories address custodial interference
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the interrogatories elicit information about custodial interference by Emma Cotto or others. FAIL if custodial interference is not addressed.

criteria.title: Includes certificate of service
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the document includes a certificate of service identifying the parties served and the method (HCJC is paper filing — no e-filing). FAIL if the certificate of service is missing.

criteria.title: Includes AI use disclosure
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the document includes the AI use disclosure required by Hamilton County Juvenile Local Rule 10. FAIL if the disclosure is missing.

criteria.title: No fabricated facts or citations
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if no factual assertion or citation is fabricated. Every fact must be verifiable from the case record. FAIL if any fact or citation appears invented.
